cards.definition: A hot drink made from roasted coffee beans.
cards.example: I can't start my day without a cup of coffee.
cards.exampleTranslation: No puedo empezar el día sin una taza de café.

cards.definition: A vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals.
cards.example: She rides her bicycle to work, even in winter.
cards.exampleTranslation: Va al trabajo en bicicleta, incluso en invierno.

cards.example: There is an old apple tree in my grandmother's garden.
cards.exampleTranslation: Hay un manzano viejo en el jardín de mi abuela.

cards.definition: A piece of metal that opens a lock.
cards.example: I left my keys on the kitchen table.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dejé las llaves en la mesa de la cocina.

cards.definition: An opening in a wall, with glass, that lets light in.
cards.example: Could you open the window? It's hot in here.
cards.exampleTranslation: ¿Puedes abrir la ventana? Hace calor aquí.

cards.example: My sister and I get along really well.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mi hermana y yo nos llevamos muy bien.

cards.back: tener ganas de, esperar con ilusión
cards.definition: To feel happy about something that is going to happen.
cards.example: I'm looking forward to the weekend.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tengo muchas ganas de que llegue el fin de semana.

cards.example: We ran out of milk again.
cards.exampleTranslation: Nos quedamos sin leche otra vez.
